does_not_authorise: any change to a frozen parameter, statistical constant, hypothesis or protocol document
any change to D1, D2, D3 or D4

checkpoint_policy.cadence: one checkpoint after every completed training episode
checkpoint_policy.retention: every intermediate checkpoint and the final checkpoint

limitations: training updates the readout parameters only; no synaptic weight is changed
a readout action label is executed because the game accepts it, not because a biological motor command was identified
this artifact is a trained parameter state; it is not evidence that a behaviour was learned and no analysis has been run on it
exact resumption is claimed only where verify_equivalence demonstrates it; the checkpoints store every B6 component they can observe
no environment RNG state is checkpointed: the controlled game is rebuilt from its B4 episode seed at each episode start

resume.environment_reason: the controlled game is reconstructed and reset from its B4 episode seed at the start of every episode; no environment RNG state survives the episode boundary, so the applicable environment provenance is the B4 seed recorded in progress.environment_seeds_used
resume.equivalence_note: equivalence is claimed only after verify_equivalence compares this resumed run with an uninterrupted run

environment.reason: the controlled game is rebuilt and reset from its B4 seed at every episode start, so no environment RNG state survives the episode boundary
